sources: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (WRNF '2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates')

hookups.source: rec.gov catalog (sites 002-024: STANDARD ELECTRIC, Electricity Hookup 30, all reservable; no water or sewer hookup on any site) + FS page ('Sites 2-24 have electric hookups, and are reservation only. There is an extra fee for the electrical service at the sites with hook-ups if the service is used'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 23 electric sites (2-24), one non-electric RV site (1) and three tent-only sites (25-27); gravel spurs, two pull-throughs (7, 20). FS and rec.gov state a 32-ft vehicle maximum; the forest's 2026 table says 35 ft and the per-site catalog lists 20-55 ft (sites 11, 12 and 21 at 20-22 ft).

sites.source: FS page ('Lowry Campground has 27 sites able to accommodate tents, trailers, and RVs. Three tent-only campsites ...'; 'All campsites are allowed 10 people and 2 vehicles only, with a maximum vehicle length of 32 feet') + rec.gov description (same 32-ft wording) + rec.gov catalog (Max Vehicle Length per site, Driveway Entry: 22 Back-In, 2 Pull-Through, all Gravel), read 2026-10-27

values.note: No water: the well is dry (FS, 2026), so bring water for the whole stay. Bear-proof food lockers at each site. Firewood sold by the hosts.

facilities.source: FS page ('The campground is equipped with picnic tables, campfire rings, and vault toilets'; 'Lowry Campground will not have water available due to the well being dry, please ensure to bring enough water for the length of your stay'; alert 'Water not available at Lowry, Prospector, Windy Point and Marvine Campgrounds') + rec.gov notice ('Bear-proof food lockers are provided at each site'), read 2026-10-27

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/media/263354 (2026 Campground and Day Use Area Operating Dates: 'Dillon Lowry CG 9,300 24/35' 5/20-10/2 $29* R'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Reserve on recreation.gov at least two days ahead; the electric sites are reservation only (FS says the three tent sites are first-come, rec.gov lists them reservable). Occupy the site the first night. Two vehicles per site, extra vehicles charged nightly. Run by a concessionaire (American Land & Leisure, 801-226-3564).

booking.source: rec.gov rules (reservationCutOff 2 days prior to arrival) + rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-20 to 2026-10-01) + notices ('Campers must occupy the site the first night'; 'Customer Service Contact 801-226-3564 or Help.WhiteRiver.Dillon@AmericanLL.com') + FS page ('Sites 2-24 have electric hookups, and are reservation only'; 'Three tent-only campsites are available on a first-come, first-serve basis'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Non-electric and tent sites $27; electric sites $38 (2026, the same in 2027-28). Extra vehicles charged nightly at the campground.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232364/rates (2026 Peak Season: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 27, STANDARD ELECTRIC 38, TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 27), read 2026-10-27

note: Dillon Ranger District campground (White River NF) off Swan Mountain Road between Summit Cove and Breckenridge, 9,320 ft, near Dillon Reservoir (body contact with the reservoir prohibited; boat ramps at the Frisco and Dillon marinas). Little or no shade since beetle-killed trees were removed. --Claude
summary: FS page + WRNF 2026 operating table + rec.gov rates/rules/catalog: confirmed 27 sites, 30-amp electric on sites 2-24 (all 23 public and reservable), rec.gov booking, $27 base with electric $38. Changed max rig 55 -> 32 ft (FS and rec.gov stated maximum). Added no water/sewer hookups, two pull-throughs, vault toilets, no potable water (well dry, 2026), season 05-20 to 10-02, booking season 05-20 to 10-01, 2-day cutoff, electric surcharge 11. Note rewritten.
